facts.fact: The World Bank's diagnostic, from fieldwork of 18-29 April 2016, states that civil registration in the municipalities is a two-book process, with entries handwritten in rural areas and typed by typewriter in most urban settings, and that the present systems for registration are paper based.
facts.system: Civil registration system (Etat Civil), two-book registers

facts.fact: The World Bank's assessment table (Annex B, fieldwork April 2016) scores 'Has ICT been introduced for the registration processes?' at 1, 'No', and the same for the management and administration of the register; the body text calls computer-based registration an isolated effort and an exception to the rule.
facts.system: Civil registration system (Etat Civil), two-book registers

facts.fact: The diagnostic states that there are 'a few instances' in Antananarivo of pilot projects of computer-based civil registration, naming the municipal offices of the IVth arrondissement, against 1,693 municipalities nationally; no count of pilot offices is given.
facts.system: Computer-based civil registration pilot, Antananarivo IVth arrondissement

facts.fact: The diagnostic states that the pilot's computer-based registration is carried out in the municipal offices of Antananarivo's IVth arrondissement with standardised software, and that records are held decentrally with no central register of civil registration records in existence.
facts.system: Computer-based civil registration pilot, Antananarivo IVth arrondissement

facts.fact: The diagnostic states that UNICEF donated the pilot's computers and the International Association of Francophone Mayors (AIMF) supplied its software, and that the initiatives lack funding for sustained use, adequate infrastructure and capacity to train staff.
facts.system: Computer-based civil registration pilot, Antananarivo IVth arrondissement

facts.fact: The diagnostic states that the civil register sits within the Ministry of the Interior, with responsibility for civil registration divided between it and the Ministry of Justice, and that the municipalities carry out registration through their own registration offices.
facts.system: Civil registration system (Etat Civil), two-book registers

facts.fact: The diagnostic states that the pre-2009 civil registration reform programme was put on hold in the crisis and that in 2016 the government was only assessing its CRVS system under APAI-CRVS (May to October 2016), ahead of any national reform plan; it names no current plan for a registration system.
facts.system: Civil registration system (Etat Civil), two-book registers

systems.system: Civil registration system (Etat Civil), two-book registers
systems.platform: paper registers, handwritten or typed; preprinted certificate forms from the Imprimerie Nationale
systems.owner: Ministry of the Interior and Ministry of Justice; kept by the municipalities
systems.tiers: municipal registration offices (1,693 municipalities); duplicate book held by the court of first instance

systems.system: Computer-based civil registration pilot, Antananarivo IVth arrondissement
systems.platform: standardised civil registration software supplied by AIMF, on computers donated by UNICEF
systems.owner: municipal offices of the IVth arrondissement, Antananarivo
systems.tiers: a few municipal offices in Antananarivo; the legal annex dates digitised storage in the IVth arrondissement (Mahamasina) from 2006

systems.platform: paper: medical notification from the health facility, or a certified notification from the fokontany for a home birth
systems.tiers: presented at the municipality when the birth is declared

systems.system: Monthly activity report (RMA) of the Ministry of Health, which includes birth registration of children
systems.owner: Ministry of Health; community health workers supported by USAID in rural areas
systems.tiers: health facilities and community health workers

systems.system: National Program for the Rehabilitation of Birth Registration (EKA)
systems.owner: government, with finance from UNICEF and the French Embassy
systems.tiers: launched 2006; retroactive registration of unregistered children by supplementary judgments, with campaigns in the southern regions

systems.system: Civil identification register and national identity card (CIN)
systems.platform: paper: manual two-book register, hand-filled card with inked fingerprints
systems.tiers: district offices, delegated to municipalities in places; central filing office for checks
18,251 fokontany; basis of residence certificates and the electoral roll
